1.0.0: MCPGateway: expose action components and MCP servers connected to the 'tool' port as MCP tools; fields marked with 'Model Defined Parameter' become tool parameters.
1.0.1: Security: upgraded uuid to 11.1.1 (missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6).
1.1.0: MCPGateway: new 'Tool descriptions' field: write what each tool is for, in the words the model reads. Without a description, a labelled component is described as '<label>: <what the component does>' instead of the component description alone.
MCPGateway: a failed tool call is logged as an error (it was an info entry), an unknown tool and a description for a tool that is not connected as warnings.
